name: Xinkgo Demo: Full
description: A tour of every capability Xinkgo's plugin host exposes: commands, data, notices, Vault and Editor adapters, metadata, network, events, ribbon and status items, plugin-owned DOM views, settings-like tabs, modals, menus, CodeMirror-style registrations and compatibility stubs. Deliberately C4/degraded: the DOM and CM6 surfaces run in the plugin's own WebView page, not in Xinkgo's native UI.
author: Xinkgo
